investigation_notes.Description: Anomalously large DNS TXT traffic (2,840 bytes vs typical 12 bytes) was observed from a production database host to a recently registered external domain. The TXT query contents are high-entropy and include base64-like fragments that decode to sensitive artifacts (RSA key header, user-agent strings, and apparent credentials), consistent with DNS-based data exfiltration. The destination is hosted via a Namecheap/CDN provider with privacy, and the domain is only ~28 days old; these indicators together support treating this as a high-priority incident requiring escalation.
